header: Press and hold: fire once at once, and, if the press is kept, again and again (after `delay`, then every `every` milliseconds) until it is let go. I use it for the spinner arrows of the colour boxes, so a held arrow changes the number one step at a time, rapidly, in its own direction. Returns the function that ends the hold; ending it twice does no harm.

symbols.name: startHold
symbols.sig: export function startHold(fire: () => void, delay: number = HOLD_DELAY_MS, every: number = HOLD_EVERY_MS): () => void

behaviours: a press steps once at once
a short press, let go before the delay, is one step only
a held press went on stepping, one step each time (many more than one)
after it is let go it steps no more (and letting go twice does no harm)
